topic: bounded primary-source review of unresolved SAQ limitations after the LP-0 Gate-A failure

candidate_families: C2 streaming updates and representation drift
C3 filtered and hybrid vector search
C4 physical layout, SIMD, and tiered storage
review_contract.inclusion_rule: Include the SAQ paper/source and a primary paper or official artifact only when it directly occupies a proposed mechanism, supplies a mandatory baseline, or states the unresolved SAQ premise.
review_contract.exclusion_rule: Exclude surveys, blogs, vendor summaries, generic ANN papers without a quantization/progressive-distance connection, and neural-model quantization not used for vector search.
search_methods: local full-text review of paper_src/2509.12086/main.tex and current SAQ source
cross-branch primary-source notes used only as pointers; claims were checked against the cited primary work

sources.title: SAQ: Pushing the Limits of Vector Quantization through Code Adjustment and Dimension Segmentation
sources.finding: SAQ is static and IVF-only; its segment-tail bound uses a configured m; arbitrary CAQ prefixes are supported empirically; and the RaBitQ-equivalent guarantee is conditional on solving a cosine objective that finite-round code adjustment need not solve optimally.

sources.title: RaBitQ: Quantizing High-Dimensional Vectors with a Theoretical Error Bound for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
sources.review_depth: primary paper and exact arXiv metadata
sources.finding: Provides an unbiased one-bit estimator and a sharp randomized error bound; it is the source of the guarantee CAQ seeks to inherit.

sources.title: Practical and Asymptotically Optimal Quantization of High-Dimensional Vectors in Euclidean Space for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
sources.review_depth: primary metadata plus the formulation reproduced and analyzed in the SAQ primary paper
sources.finding: Extends RaBitQ to multiple bits with theoretical guarantees and an exact/pruned codeword search; only its most-significant bit is guaranteed to recover a valid RaBitQ code, so arbitrary intermediate prefixes are not its mechanism.

sources.title: High-Dimensional Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search: with Reliable and Efficient Distance Comparison Operations
sources.review_depth: primary paper and exact arXiv metadata
sources.finding: ADSampling already supplies high-probability, progressively sampled distance comparisons and generic ANN-index plugins.

sources.title: Efficient Data-aware Distance Comparison Operations for High-Dimensional Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
sources.finding: Uses PCA prefixes and hypothesis tests to adapt distance-computation depth per candidate in IVF and HNSW.

sources.title: Quantization Meets Projection: A Happy Marriage for Approximate k-Nearest Neighbor Search
sources.finding: Directly combines a quantized PCA head, residual-tail statistics, probabilistic bounds, and multi-stage IVF refinement.

sources.title: SymphonyQG: Towards Symphonious Integration of Quantization and Graph
sources.review_depth: primary paper and pinned official-source parity from the graph branch
sources.finding: Integrates RaBitQ/FastScan estimates and graph-side sequential code layout into traversal, occupying graph-aware certified-quantizer integration and layout.

sources.title: Online Product Quantization
sources.finding: Incrementally updates PQ codebooks for insertion, deletion, and sliding-window streams with update cost independent of database size.

sources.title: Online Optimized Product Quantization
sources.finding: Updates both product codebooks and an orthonormal rotation online, colliding with a generic online-PCA/rotation extension.

sources.title: DeDrift: Robust Similarity Search under Content Drift
sources.finding: Shows that coarse-IVF and residual-code drift is a major confound and provides split, lazy, and hybrid local repair mechanisms.

sources.title: SPFresh: Incremental In-Place Update for Billion-Scale Vector Search
sources.finding: Uses local posting split/merge and reassignment to repair dynamic partition imbalance without global rebuild.

sources.title: Locally-Adaptive Quantization for Streaming Vector Search
sources.finding: Finds that frozen LVQ statistics can match repeatedly rebuilt controls under tested drift, so stale global state does not itself establish a search limitation.

sources.title: Incremental IVF Index Maintenance for Streaming Vector Search
sources.finding: Uses reconstruction error, imbalance, and query temperature to trigger local IVF reconstruction; its query-aware component conflicts with the current branch contract.

sources.title: Quantization for Vector Search under Streaming Updates
sources.finding: CoDEQ targets dynamically consistent data-dependent product-style quantization with bounded dependent disk I/O per update, creating the strongest collision for a generic dynamic-SAQ proposal.

sources.title: AnalyticDB-V: A Hybrid Analytical Engine Towards Query Fusion for Structured and Unstructured Data
sources.finding: Already treats predicate selectivity, PQ distance cost, and pre/post-filter execution as a physical-plan decision.

sources.title: VBASE: Unifying Online Vector Similarity Search and Relational Queries via Relaxed Monotonicity
sources.finding: Provides generic iterator exposure, dynamic termination, and selectivity-based scalar/vector execution for filtered vector queries.

sources.title: Filtered-DiskANN: Graph Algorithms for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search with Filters
sources.review_depth: author primary paper and official artifact
sources.finding: Shows that filtered search primarily creates a label-aware graph-connectivity and candidate-generation problem.

sources.title: ACORN: Performant and Predicate-Agnostic Search over Vector Embeddings and Structured Data
sources.review_depth: publisher primary paper and official artifact
sources.finding: Makes graph traversal and fallback explicitly selectivity-dependent for arbitrary predicates.

sources.title: E2E: Adaptive Early Termination for Filtered Vector Search
sources.finding: Learns per-query termination from early filter and distance signals; it directly collides with selectivity-dependent staging and is query-supervised.

sources.title: An Experimental Evaluation of Hybrid Querying on Vectors
sources.review_depth: publisher primary paper and official artifact
sources.finding: Establishes pass rate, attribute correlation, and pre/post-filter strategy as mandatory controlled factors.

sources.title: Cache Locality is Not Enough: High-Performance Nearest Neighbor Search with Product Quantization Fast Scan
sources.finding: Establishes register-resident lookup tables, SIMD-friendly code grouping, and layout changes as first-class quantized-scan mechanisms.

sources.title: Accelerated Nearest Neighbor Search with Quick ADC
sources.review_depth: primary paper and exact arXiv metadata
sources.finding: Uses four-bit subquantizers and quantized lookup tables to unlock register SIMD and reports three-to-six-fold ADC speedups.

sources.title: Quicker ADC: Unlocking the Hidden Potential of Product Quantization with SIMD
sources.review_depth: primary paper, exact arXiv metadata, and official artifact
sources.finding: Generalizes register lookup to irregular five-, six-, and seven-bit codes and AVX-512 split tables across several ANN indexes.

sources.title: Bolt: Accelerated Data Mining with Fast Vector Compression
sources.review_depth: primary paper and exact arXiv metadata
sources.finding: Jointly optimizes fast encoding, compressed-vector operations, and hardware-friendly lookup rather than treating code layout as an SAQ-specific gap.

sources.title: AiSAQ: All-in-Storage ANNS with Product Quantization for DRAM-free Information Retrieval
sources.review_depth: primary paper and exact arXiv metadata
sources.finding: Moves compressed graph-search state into SSD and demonstrates billion-scale search with about ten megabytes of DRAM.

sources.title: FaTRQ: Tiered Residual Quantization for LLM Vector Search in Far-Memory-Aware ANNS Systems
sources.review_depth: primary preprint and exact arXiv metadata
sources.finding: Already makes progressive residual refinement a tiered-memory mechanism with a provable early-stop rule and a CXL-side accelerator.

sources.title: Similarity Search in the Blink of an Eye with Compressed Indices
sources.finding: Supplies the per-vector scalar-quantization initialization used by CAQ and an optimized compressed-index systems baseline.

sources.title: NestQuant: Nested Lattice Quantization for Matrix Products and LLMs
sources.finding: Shows that nested precision quantization is a broader established design, although its workload is not ANN search.

sources.title: Successive Refinement Lattice Vector Quantization
sources.finding: Bitplane-like successive-refinement vector quantization predates SAQ, so nested-prefix quantization alone is not novel.

sources.title: Multiresolution Vector Quantization
sources.finding: Studies embedded source descriptions and supplies a classical collision for generic prefix-consistent vector codes.

sources.title: Optimized Product Quantization
sources.finding: A mandatory learned-rotation/quantization objective control, but it does not solve CAQ's per-vector discrete cosine codeword problem.

sources.title: LSQ++: Lower Running Time and Higher Recall in Multi-Codebook Quantization
sources.finding: Optimizes multi-codebook assignments and encoding time, but does not remove the exact E-RaBitQ versus finite-round CAQ objective comparison.

sources.title: TurboQuant: Online Vector Quantization with Near-optimal Distortion Rate
sources.finding: Provides a modern random-rotation scalar-quantizer control; it targets distortion rate rather than certification of CAQ's discrete cosine optimum.

review_limits: Recent 2025-2026 preprints were used as novelty collisions, not treated as established peer-reviewed results unless a venue is listed.
The review establishes whether a bounded falsification gate is defensible; it does not establish a new method or a universal SAQ limitation.

E-RaBitQ full-text retrieval was unavailable in the current network session; its metadata and the exact formulation reproduced in the local SAQ primary source were used. Any later oracle implementation requires a separate official-source parity review.
